Message:
Hehe! Soon, a new butler will
come to work at this estate!

All of the previous servants
quit so quickly,
I know I shouldn’t
get my hopes up, but...

My...! What charming gray eyes.
They even shine faintly
in the light...!

Hehe, it seems that yet
another adorable bird
has come to stay here
with me this year.

It’s strange...
But, when I speak with her,
it feels as though
she’s an old friend...

Perhaps that’s why...
even though we’ve only just met,
I can’t help but keep
prattling on about myself...

Hehe, this does
bring back memories, though.
I often used to
talk with my little sister
like this, didn’t I...?

It makes me want to
see my family again even more...

“I do hope the lord and lady
come back for you soon.”

I wonder why...
Moineau said it so kindly...

And yet, somehow...
it felt as though she was lying...
